facts.fact: The Information Regulator fined the Department of Basic Education R5 million on 23 December 2024 under POPIA for ignoring an enforcement notice on publishing matric results.
The Information Regulator, chaired by Adv Pansy Tlakula, enforces POPIA and issued both notices against the Department of Basic Education.
The Regulator applied POPIA's enforcement and offence provisions (sections 97 and 109) to the Department of Basic Education in December 2024.
